distros.symptom: Catastrophic failure / Error code: Wsl/Service/E_UNEXPECTED on every launch
distros.cause: Ubuntu 26.04 is cgroup v2 only (systemd 259). WSL runtimes before 2.5.1 mount a hybrid cgroup v1 hierarchy, so systemd cannot start and the distro never boots; 2.5.7 is the first stable runtime without cgroup v1. Derived from source and release notes; VM confirmation pending.
